name: Variables and Data Types
description: Primitive types, variable assignment, type casting, and fundamental memory allocation.

name: Basic Arithmetic and Logic
description: Arithmetic operators, boolean logic, operator precedence, and truth tables.

name: Conditional Statements
description: Branching execution paths using if-else structures, switch blocks, and ternary operators.

name: Loops and Iteration
description: Repetitive execution control using for, while, and do-while loops with break/continue control.

name: Functions and Scope
description: Modular code decomposition, parameter passing, return values, and variable lifetimes.

name: Memory and Pointers Basics
description: Stack versus heap memory architecture, reference semantics, and memory addressing.

name: Arrays and Memory Contiguity
description: Contiguous memory storage, zero-indexed random access, and multi-dimensional grids.

name: Strings and Character Arrays
description: Character encoding, immutable vs mutable string manipulation, and string traversal.

name: Time and Space Complexity
description: Asymptotic analysis, Big-O, Big-Omega, Big-Theta notation, and worst/average case bounds.

name: Recursion Basics
description: Self-referential functions, recursive call stacks, base cases, and recursion trees.

name: Bit Manipulation
description: Bitwise AND, OR, XOR, NOT operations, bit masks, and binary shifts.

name: Singly Linked Lists
description: Dynamic node linking, head pointers, sequential traversal, insertion, and deletion.

name: Stacks and LIFO Operations
description: Last-in First-out collection, push/pop/peek operations, and expression evaluation.

name: Queues and FIFO Operations
description: First-in First-out collection, enqueue/dequeue operations, and circular buffer queues.

name: Linear and Binary Search
description: Linear scanning versus logarithmic divide-and-search over monotonic collections.

name: Two Pointers and Sliding Window
description: Coordinate tracking patterns for sub-arrays, monotonic search, and linear window contraction.

name: Elementary Sorting Algorithms
description: Quadratic sorting routines including bubble sort, selection sort, and insertion sort.

name: Doubly and Circular Linked Lists
description: Bidirectional node pointer links, circular buffer traversal, and edge node handling.

name: Divide and Conquer
description: Recursive subproblem partitioning, independent solutions, and master theorem analysis.

name: Hash Tables and Hash Maps
description: Hashing functions, bucket arrays, collision handling via chaining and open addressing.

name: Binary Trees and Traversals
description: Hierarchical node branching, in-order, pre-order, post-order, and level-order traversal.

name: Binary Search Trees
description: Ordered binary search trees, BST invariant validation, insertion, search, and deletion.

name: Heaps and Priority Queues
description: Complete binary trees as arrays, min-heap and max-heap properties, sift-up, and sift-down.

name: Graph Representation
description: Vertices and edges modeled as adjacency matrices, adjacency lists, and edge arrays.

name: Merge Sort and Quick Sort
description: O(N log N) divide-and-conquer sorting with merge operations and pivot partitioning.

name: Self-Balancing Binary Trees
description: Logarithmic depth guarantee via tree rotations, balance factors, AVL trees, and Red-Black trees.

name: Tries and Prefix Trees
description: Multiway tree structure for efficient dictionary retrieval, prefix search, and autocomplete.

name: Breadth-First Search
description: Queue-driven level-by-level graph traversal, shortest paths in unweighted graphs.

name: Depth-First Search
description: Stack-driven graph traversal, cycle detection, connected components, and pathfinding.

name: Greedy Algorithms
description: Locally optimal choice heuristics, greedy choice property, and optimal substructure.

name: Disjoint Set Union
description: Disjoint set union-find, path compression, and union by rank optimizations.

name: Dynamic Programming Fundamentals
description: Overlapping subproblems, optimal substructure, top-down memoization vs bottom-up tabulation.

name: Topological Sorting and DAGs
description: Linear ordering of vertices in directed acyclic graphs using Kahn's algorithm and DFS.

name: Minimum Spanning Trees
description: Kruskal's and Prim's algorithms for minimum weight spanning tree discovery.

name: Shortest Path Algorithms
description: Dijkstra's priority-queue algorithm and Bellman-Ford negative cycle relaxation.

name: 1D Dynamic Programming
description: Linear state transition equations, 0/1 knapsack, longest increasing subsequence, and coin change.

name: 2D and Grid Dynamic Programming
description: Matrix state representations, edit distance, longest common subsequence, and grid paths.

name: Backtracking and State Space Search
description: Recursive state space exploration, constraint satisfaction, N-Queens, and Sudoku solving.
